outcome: Anxiety levels (measured by Visual Analogue Scale - VAS)
cohort: Sixty women undergoing multiple cesarean sections were randomly assigned to either an experimental group (music) or a control group (no music).
finding: Music therapy significantly reduced the physiological and cognitive responses of anxiety in patients undergoing multiple cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Music therapy played during cesarean section was found to reduce anxiety in women undergoing this mode of birth.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from June 2015 to June 2016.
